title: "Ensuring Cleanup Runs on Exit"
---

# Ensuring Cleanup Runs on Exit

The pseudo-signal `EXIT` (or `0`) runs when the shell exits for any reason (normal finish, `exit` call, or `set -e` abort):

```bash
TEMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "${TEMP_DIR}"' EXIT

# Even if a command fails below with set -e, TEMP_DIR is guaranteed to be deleted!
curl -sS https://example.com/data.tar.gz | tar -xz -C "$TEMP_DIR"
```
